LanguageData.RimMind.Settings.ApiEndpoint.Desc: AI service API address. Supports OpenAI-compatible interfaces (e.g. DeepSeek, local Ollama).

LanguageData.RimMind.Settings.MaxTokens.Desc: Maximum tokens per AI response. Higher values allow longer replies but increase cost.

LanguageData.RimMind.Settings.DebugLogging.Desc: Output detailed AI request and response info to Player.log for troubleshooting.
LanguageData.RimMind.Settings.Player2.Desc: Player2 is an AI gaming assistant platform. When selected, the system will auto-detect the local Player2 desktop app and authenticate, no API Key needed. If the local app is not installed, you can also enter an API Key manually.
LanguageData.RimMind.Settings.Player2.ApiKeyDesc: Player2 prioritizes local desktop app auto-authentication. Only enter an API Key manually if the local app is not installed.

LanguageData.RimMind.Settings.MaxConcurrent.Desc: Maximum number of simultaneous AI requests. Higher values improve responsiveness but increase API costs.
LanguageData.RimMind.Settings.MaxRetry.Desc: Maximum number of retries after a request failure. Set to 0 to disable retries.
LanguageData.RimMind.Settings.RequestTimeout.Desc: Maximum time to wait for an AI response before timing out. Increase for slow models or networks.
LanguageData.RimMind.Settings.RequestExpireTicks.Desc: Requests older than this tick count are automatically removed from the queue. Prevents stale requests from accumulating. Range: 6000-120000.
LanguageData.RimMind.Settings.BehaviorHistoryMax.Desc: Maximum number of behavior history records retained per agent. Higher values provide more context but increase token usage. Range: 10-500.
LanguageData.RimMind.Settings.QueueProcessInterval.De: Interval in ticks between queue processing cycles. Lower values process requests faster but consume more CPU. Range: 10-300.
LanguageData.RimMind.Settings.DefaultModCooldown.Desc: Default cooldown in ticks between consecutive requests for the same mod. Prevents API rate limiting. Individual mods may override this. Range: 600-36000.

LanguageData.RimMind.Prompt.TaskInstruction.Base:
You are in the RimWorld game world.

Output constraints:
- You must return valid JSON format
- Do not wrap in markdown code blocks
- If you cannot determine, return a default value or empty result

Behavior constraints:
- Do not break the fourth wall
- Do not mention game mechanics, code, data structures, or the concept of "player"
- Act naturally as your character
